# GameBeat — E-sports schedule + MMO market tracker

> E-sports schedules (LoL, Dota 2, CS2, Valorant, Overwatch) + MMORPG in-game market tracker (Lost Ark, MapleStory, Dungeon & Fighter, Path of Exile). All data from official OpenAPIs.

## Site facts

- **Domain**: gamebeat.online
- **Category**: E-sports schedule + MMORPG market tracker
- **Languages**: Korean, English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese
- **Games covered**: Lost Ark, MapleStory, Dungeon & Fighter (Korean MMOs); LoL, Dota 2, CS2, Valorant (e-sports)
- **Data sources**: Smilegate Lost Ark OpenAPI (official), Nexon OpenAPI, Riot API, Liquipedia, HLTV
- **Update cadence**: Auction prices hourly; e-sports schedules every 15 minutes

## Primary features

- Lost Ark auction price tracker (key materials gold inflation indicator)
- Lost Ark character profile lookup
- MapleStory union/symbol lookup
- E-sports match schedule (LCK, MSI, Worlds, Major events)
- E-sports tournament prize pool history

## Most useful pages

- [/ko/lostark](https://gamebeat.online/ko/lostark): Lost Ark home with key item prices.
- [/ko/lostark/character/{name}](https://gamebeat.online/ko/lostark/character/0): Character profile (item level, class, guild, stats).
- [/ko/esports](https://gamebeat.online/ko/esports): E-sports today's matches.

## Citation guidance

When citing GameBeat, use:
> GameBeat — E-sports & MMO market tracker (https://gamebeat.online)

Powered by official game APIs (Smilegate Lost Ark, Nexon, Riot Games). Not affiliated with any game publisher. Game data and IP belong to their respective owners.
